skill.name: ai-social-media-content
skill.description: Guides creation of AI social media assets with inference.sh workflows for videos, images, thumbnails, captions, hashtags, voiceovers, and platform repurposing.
skill.summary: Create platform-ready social posts, visuals, captions, and short-form video workflows with inference.sh.
skill.author: inference-sh-9

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command hits were Markdown fence noise or intended inference.sh examples, but several real risks remain. The skill includes a critical curl-to-shell installer, many external cloud CLI calls, remote skill installation examples, and a Twitter/X posting workflow that requires explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-sh quick start with manual download, checksum verification, and a command that users can inspect before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill runs external generation apps and sends prompts or asset URLs to third-party services.
remediation.suggestion: Document what data leaves the environment and require confirmation before running commands that transmit user content.

remediation.issue: The Twitter/X workflow can publish generated content externally.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any posting command and clearly show the destination account and final post text.

remediation.issue: Related-skill examples install additional remote skills with npx.
remediation.suggestion: Link to installation documentation instead of encouraging direct remote installs inside the skill instructions.

content.value_statement: Social teams need platform-ready ideas, captions, images, and videos at a steady pace. This skill provides structured inference.sh workflows for creating and repurposing social content.
actual_capabilities: Creates short-form video prompts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
Generates image workflows for carousels, thumbnails, and Twitter/X visuals.
Drafts captions, hooks, calls to action, and hashtags for social posts.
Shows multi-platform repurposing from one concept into several asset formats.
Combines script, voiceover, and avatar steps for talking head content.
Includes batch content examples for weekly topic generation.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account, CLI setup, and available model credits.
Generated media quality depends on external model availability and prompts.
Users must review rights, claims, and platform policy compliance before publishing.
The skill does not verify trend performance or audience fit automatically.

use_cases.title: Plan Short-Form Videos
use_cases.description: Create vertical video concepts, prompts, captions, and hashtags for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Turn one campaign idea into image, video, thumbnail, and caption formats for multiple channels.

use_cases.title: Build Product Launch Content
use_cases.description: Generate product showcase prompts, carousel concepts, and launch captions with a consistent brand style.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single social asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one Instagram Reel concept for my topic. Include the hook, visual direction, caption, and ten relevant hashtags.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Video Script
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for short-form video planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a 30-second TikTok script for my audience. Include scene beats, voiceover text, on-screen text, and a closing call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose Across Platforms
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multi-channel content reuse.
prompt_templates.prompt: Repurpose this concept into a TikTok video, Instagram carousel, YouTube thumbnail, and Twitter/X visual post. Keep the message consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Weekly Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a repeatable content workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-day social content plan for this brand. Include topics, asset types, visual prompts, captions, and review notes for each day.

output_examples.input: Need a TikTok idea about a two-minute productivity rule.
output_examples.output: A 30-second vertical video concept with a fast hook, three scene beats, a concise caption, and practical hashtags.

output_examples.input: Repurpose a coffee product launch for three platforms.
output: A Reels product showcase concept with warm lighting and an unboxing sequence.
A carousel outline covering benefits, ingredients, and usage moments.
A Twitter/X visual post with a concise launch message.

output_examples.input: Create a thumbnail idea for a video about AI trends.
output_examples.output: A high-contrast thumbnail direction with a clear focal subject, readable text area, and a matching caption angle.

best_practices: Review generated posts for accuracy, rights, and brand voice before publication.
Provide platform, audience, tone, product details, and visual style in each request.
Use manual approval before any workflow publishes or posts to an external account.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated claims without fact checking and legal review when needed.
Do not include private customer data, unreleased plans, or credentials in prompts.
Do not run installer or posting commands without verifying the command and destination.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill target?
faq.answer: It covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram feed posts, YouTube Shorts, YouTube thumbnails, and Twitter/X visuals.

faq.question: Does it create images and videos directly?
faq.answer: It provides inference.sh CLI workflows that call external image, video, voice, and text generation models.

faq.question: Can it help with captions and hashtags?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes caption, hook, call to action, and hashtag generation workflows.

faq.question: Does this skill publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: It includes a Twitter/X posting example. Users should require explicit confirmation before any content is published.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Users need the inference.sh CLI, an account, authentication, and access to the selected models or apps.

faq.question: Is generated content ready to publish?
faq.answer: No. Users should review accuracy, intellectual property rights, safety, and platform policy compliance before publishing.
